title: Who Knows
lyrics:
[00:00] I'll probably be a waste of your time, but who knows?
[00:04] Chances are I'll step out of line, but who knows?
[00:08] Lately, you've set up in my mind
[00:12] Yeah, girl, you, and I like that
[00:16] Lately, I've been thinking that perhaps I am a coward
[00:20] Hiding in a disguise of an ever-giving flower
[00:24] Incompetent steward of all of that sweet, sweet power
[00:28] Yesterday was feeling so good, now it's gone
[00:32] I'd feel like that always if I could, is that wrong?
[00:36] Tell me 'bout the city you're from
[00:40] Is it hot? Does it snow there?
[00:44] Lately, I've been thinking 'bout my precarious future
[00:48] Will you be there with me by my side, my girl, my shooter?
[00:52] Who's to say who calculates? Not me, I'm no computer
[00:56] Is it a crime to be unsure?
[01:00] In time we'll find... If it's sustainable...
[01:04] You're pure, you're kind... Mature, divine...
[01:08] You might be too good for me, unattainable
[01:12] Maybe we get married one day, but who knows?
[01:16] Think I'll take that thought to the grave, but who knows?
[01:20] I know that I'll love you always
[01:24] Yeah, girl you, and I'd like that
